text:
deploybot: :warning: Canary #2 for release embed-prod:v2.1.8 showing elevated 5xx and CPU spikes. Canary failure rate ~22% over 4m. Rollout ID r-2026-03-21-6370. Options: pin traffic back to v2.1.6 at LB, rollback canary only, or fast patch. Need decision for expedited action.

sam: oncall - seeing `tokenize_batch()` latency jumps and OOM-ish retry loops in the logs. Affects ~30% of requests hitting canary.

neha: agree we shouldn't continue the rollout. Prefer to pin LB and rollback canary subset, so we avoid global flip. @ops-lee can you do a quick LB pin and targeted rollback?

ops-lee: I can pin at the load-balancer and then scale down the canary pods. Need release-lead signoff for expedited rollback. I'll publish audit links after.

release-lead: signoff granted for pin + canary rollback. Prioritize minimal blast radius. Notify SRE pager if anything weird. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: CI note: build r-2026-03-21-6370 passed unit/e2e but perf regression detected in tokenization benchmark on staging (3% higher p95). Flagged in CI dashboard: https://ci.internal/builds/r-2026-03-21-6370/report

ops-lee: executing LB pin -> routing embed-prod traffic to v2.1.6 backend pool. Command: `gcloud compute backendServices update embed-prod-bs --global --remove-backends canary-v2-1-8` -> applied.

sam: confirming LB now routes 100% to v2.1.6. Observability: 5xx dropping on user-facing metrics.

ops-lee: rolling back canary deployment only to v2.1.6 image tag, keeping stable pool untouched. Commands: \n```\n# patch canary deployment image\nkubectl -n prod set image deploy/embed-prod-canary embed=registry.redwood/embed:v2.1.6-canary-pinned --record\n# scale to safe size\nkubectl -n prod scale deploy/embed-prod-canary --replicas=2\nkubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/embed-prod-canary\```\n
neha: watching smoke tests for embed latency and error counts on the pinned canary. Start 10m smoke now.

ci-bot: smoke test started: https://ci.internal/smoke/r-2026-03-21-6370/canary-smoke

sam: smoke looks clean at 5m mark, no tokenization regressions in traces. Will keep monitoring for the next 5m.

ops-lee: audit record: https://audit.internal/ops/6370012345/pin-rollback - LB pin applied, canary patched back to v2.1.6-canary-pinned, replicas=2.

release-lead: thanks team. We'll open a postmortem; actionable items: add a perf gate to CI for tokenization p95, add a rollout guard that blocks canary promotion on CPU anomalies, and schedule a dedicated repro run.

neha: created ticket REL-2026-412 (perf gate + rollout guard) and linked CI failure.

sam: will run a small repro in staging and share logs.

deploybot: deploybot: Canary alert cleared for r-2026-03-21-6370. Rollout remains blocked until root cause is fixed and new canary pass is observed. Thread closed by release-lead."
